meta.name: context-engineering-collection
meta.description: A comprehensive collection of Agent Skills for context engineering, multi-agent architectures, and production agent systems. Use when building, optimizing, or debugging agent systems that require effective context management.

copy.tagline: 提升多代理系统的上下文管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建或调试多代理系统,并需要精细控制上下文
copy.tagline_en: Improve context management in multi-agent systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build or debug multi-agent systems needing precise context control

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会基于这套技能指导你构建、优化或调试智能体系统:先讲上下文基础,再选多智能体架构、记忆与文件系统、工具设计,最后用压缩、优化和评估手段提升表现。
howto.when: 当你说要构建、优化或调试需要有效管理上下文的 agent 系统时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新 agent 系统的上下文策略,该从哪些方面入手?
say.note: 会从上下文基础技能入手给出入门框架。

say.text: 我的 agent 在长对话里越来越不准,怎么优化上下文管理?
say.note: 会结合上下文退化与优化技能分析原因。

say.text: 多智能体架构有哪些常见模式?各适合什么场景?
say.note: 会引用多智能体模式技能做对比说明。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude gives structured advice on building, optimizing, or debugging agent systems—covering context fundamentals, multi-agent architecture, memory/filesystem patterns, tool design, and compression/optimization/evaluation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build, optimize, or debug an agent system that needs effective context management.

say_en.text: Help me design a context strategy for a new agent system. Where do I start?
say_en.note: Uses the context-fundamentals skill for initial framework.

say_en.text: My agent gets worse in long chats. How do I improve context?
say_en.note: Uses context-degradation and context-optimization to analyze.

say_en.text: What are the common multiagent architecture patterns and when to use each?
